beats.headline: A basketball on three legs
beats.text: For the record: a second adjutant appears beside Baroness Victory, a type of alien Crawler Carl has never seen. A round, basketball-like body covered in black dots that may be eyes, standing on three long, multi-jointed legs. A tripod. Tripods are supposedly completely without emotion. Former Prime Minister Fopsy. Adjutant for The Dream. Non-combatant observer. He says nothing and scuttles aside. His arrival makes Crawler Carl realise that the Dream's warlord must be inside the ball of flesh as well.

beats.headline: Five potions for a Gate
beats.text: His first words, when a woman shoots out of the ball, are that the ruleset has nothing for this, and there is nothing to do but observe and report. Then the adjutants talk past Crawler Carl. Bao has not called foul. A spell to do this would need level 19, perhaps 18, and would not work on sponsored gods, which explains the ejection. Victory says potions. The subject checks his menus, every eye twinkling like a disco ball: the war mages traded the Gate of the Feral Gods at the Midnight Market for five of them.

beats.headline: A theory kept back
beats.text: The subject's reading of the war mages' warlord: the residual is not only trying to win Faction Wars and zero out the crawlers, but to end the ascendency game fast. Once it is finished with no crawlers left, a hard-coded shutdown and hibernation follows, an alternative to the failsafe. That makes sense if she believes the local AI is a threat to the Eulogist. How she convinced the war mages, he does not understand. He has additional theories, and declines to voice them in the presence of a combatant.

beats.headline: Get fucked, Prime Minister
beats.text: He teleports into the Nest Tower without Crawler Carl hearing a thing, and his presence reminds Crawler Carl that two warlords, Tagg and Fang, are still unaccounted for. Rosetta arrives out of breath with Edgar the tortoise strapped to her back and does a double take at him. Former prime minister, she says, and grins. Get fucked. But she is glad he is here to witness this.

beats.headline: Quite clever, says the tripod
beats.text: A second net is holding Crawler Carl and Crawler Donut inside the Nest Tower, and the two adjutants diagnose it while watching. Victory calls it classic Lucia Mar. The subject agrees: her first net was a personal one from a scroll, and she likely cast a second in case of a countermeasure, which sat waiting for a power source. Victory names it Power Siphon, drawing on the tower jewels in Larracos. Quite clever, says the subject. Crawler Carl, who has already ordered Lucia to turn it all off, is less impressed.

beats.headline: An outline in the power view
beats.text: At one point both adjutants are simply gone, and Crawler Carl never sees them leave. Then, at the front of the castle, the Reavers' antlered adjutant whispers to someone over his left shoulder, where nobody is standing. Crawler Donut cannot see through the invisibility, but switching to the power view gives her a rough outline: that weird alien who looks like a basketball on stilts. Fopsy. With both missing warlords' adjutants present, Crawler Carl concludes the trap is looking more likely, calls off the fooling around, and switches to plan B.

beats.headline: No inkling whatsoever
beats.text: He and Victory return with a crack from a virtual meeting of the Syndicate Council, called back because the AI was throwing a fit about them missing all this. A No Confidence vote on Glory is under way. Tagg was secretly moving toward the post-physical path, and Victory notes that, depending on the vote, the subject might be Prime Minister again, which is doubly interesting in the Dream's own adjutant. He had no idea, he says. No inkling whatsoever, though it makes sense now, considering some clues.

beats.headline: Passed over for Prime Minister
beats.text: Asked when the stairwells appear, Victory says immediately; the subject corrects her: about ten seconds. The office goes elsewhere. Victory reports that because people were not certain of former Prime Minister Fopsy's relationship to the Dream, he was passed over for the newly vacated position of Syndicate Prime Minister. She is acting Prime Minister Victory now, with a real vote in a few months. Rosetta sounds strangely irritated at the news.
